coherent_oracle.note: Unlearnable per-network sigma-shaped amplitude projection; independent A/B noise cross-term expected zero.

distinctness: Prior full-head and feature fits used pointwise inputs. This tests a network-shared coefficient from neuron-pooledstate64 (fixed4 unlabeled PCA components plus intercept), multiplying each neuron sigma.
limitation: This closes only the fixed pooled4 normalized-bias hypothesis on existing S2tr TRAIN97, not arbitrary global-context models or currentv17 distributions. No PCA rank/ridge/response-shape sweep justified by this result.
